springConvention.responseMeaning: undamped natural period; not an animation duration
springConvention.retarget: current position and velocity; avoid restarting at zero
springConvention.fixedDuration: for constrained 150ms/500ms tracks use stated curve, not a cut spring

haptics.deduplicate: one per committed event ID, not per rebuild; no catch-up when returning to foreground
haptics.timing: request time relative to actual event; platform scheduling is not sample-accurate
haptics.reduced: meaningful single feedback retained; respect platform setting; never a repeating pattern

global.motionMustNotGateActions: Never delay backend work, a navigation already requested, or a safety action. Match CTA has the explicit850..1000ms visual cue from the approved plan; reduced150ms.
global.reducedReadAtRuntime: AccessibilityFeatures.reduceMotion OR disableAnimations, plus MediaQuery disableAnimations; update live
global.functionalPendingReduced: static status and determinate jumps, no rotating spinner per approved plan
